name: Hero's Entrance: MR-to-damage landing
objective: Explore high one Hero's Entrance landing impact output under a finite setup; compare item swaps without claiming a universal maximum.
mechanic: The landing helper is 150/250/350 + 0.70 AP + 1.0 bonus magic resist as magic damage. Defensive MR can therefore feed this offensive packet, while the ally magic shield is a different output.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy: 10000 max HP, 100 armor, 50 MR and 100% starting HP. Owner HP at the selected event: 100%. No dragons, elixirs or external allied buffs. Record actual final stats and eligible modifiers. Keep raw and effective output separate; stop damage at death and cap effective healing at missing HP. One legal rank-3 R cast on an allied champion. Enemy champion remains in the actual landing area. Record bonus MR separately from base MR and AP immediately before impact; Maw Lifeline remains untriggered and no allied resist buffs are present.
test: Compare MR/AP slots with pure AP and magic penetration at fixed enemy MR. Separate landing, ally shield, rune damage and item procs. Record the actual dynamic stat state at landing instead of assuming the cast snapshots it.
limits: No total MR substituted for bonus MR, magic shield capacity counted as damage, incoming magic damage converted into a second impact or Maw AP/healing effects invented. Target must actually be hit by landing.
tradeoff: The large MR-assisted impact requires an allied landing anchor and a slow, visible arrival.
